source.title: ImPure Injection Molding Sensor Data - Trial 17th May
source.description: ImPure project, open access data from PASCOE IM line.

sourceVerification.fingerprintManifestMethod: SHA-256 over sorted lines name|md5|sha256|sizeBytes|rows|columns for all 309 exact source files

cycleCoverage.note: Cycle number range is not treated as cycle count; only the 307 checksum-verified cycle CSV files count.

measurementSemantics.note: Six channel names unambiguously identify hydraulic pressure, screw position, two mould temperatures and two pressure channels. Their physical units and the Time-field basis are not explicitly encoded in the published cycle headers, so none of these scalar values are counted in the accepted measured-time-series ledger yet.

qualityEvidence.note: The separate quality files are source-fingerprinted and retained as measured quality evidence. Their row cardinalities are recorded without inventing a one-to-one join beyond the published cycle/cavity fields.

boundary: PASCOE is accepted as one fully profiled real measured dataset package because the exact open CC BY 4.0 source was obtained, all 309 files were checksum-verified, the 307 real cycle CSVs were enumerated and schema-profiled, direct named sensor channels were separated from unknown analog inputs, and source quality files were fingerprinted. The measured scalar sample ledger remains unchanged until source units and Time-field semantics are explicitly verified.
